outcome: Give Tech teams a working AI Code Review & Developer Productivity Copilot capability on their own data — it teams ship ~30% faster with fewer production bugs.
overview: Delivery slows at the review queue: pull requests wait on the same few senior engineers, and thin test coverage lets regressions through to production, where rework consumes sprint capacity. This copilot reviews each pull request inside the tools developers already use, summarising intent, flagging risky changes against the wider codebase, and drafting the tests the change is missing. It comments; it never approves or merges, and a named human reviewer stays accountable for what ships. A four-week build on live repositories with pilot teams shows whether lead time for change and change-failure rate actually move, measured against this organisation’s own baseline rather than a benchmark.
